name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
about: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited, incorporated in 1993 , is a Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) company with operations in the electronic products vertical such as consumer electronics, lighting, home appliance, closed-circuit television cameras (CCTVs), and mobile phones. It also undertakes reverse logistics operations.

guidance.extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.metric: Q2 smartphone volume growth over Q1
items.quote: Our market position, customer engagement and manufacturing capabilities remain intact, and we expect 20% to 25% volume g rowth quarter- on-quarter growth as consumer demand strengthens and we have a strong order book.
items.actual: About 9.7 million in Q2 against 7.5 million in Q1
items.why: Smartphone volumes went from about 7.5 million in Q1 to about 9.7 million in Q2, roughly 29% higher.
items.actual_quote: So total in H1, that is Q1 and Q2 combined, up to September, we have done approximately 17.2 million.

items.quote: Construction of our 1 million square feet facility in Noida with higher capacities for our anchor customers is nearing completion, and we expect the operation to commence by Q2 this fiscal.
items.why: In October the start was pushed to Q3 FY27.
items.actual_quote: Construction of a 1 million square feet facility in Noida with higher capacities has almost been completed, and we expect the operations to commence from Q3 of this fiscal.

items.promise: 180 to 190 million a year within 15 to 18 months
items.quote: We will be expand ing the capacities of camera module and a subsidiary Q Tech, which is an ECMS beneficiary for smartphones from 70 million units annually to around 180 million units to 190 million units annually over the next 15 to 18 months, largely catering to our captiv e smartphone volumes in addition to deepening the level of manufacturing, capturing more value add in India.
items.why: Capacity is already at 120 million, and the company still expects 180 to 190 million by next fiscal.
items.actual_quote: We have already expanded our capacities from 80 million to 120 million annually, along with deepened manufacturing, which is margin accretive, and will further expand its capacity to 180 to 190 million units annually by next fiscal.

bull.text: Management is delivering: 2 of 3 checkable promises kept or on track
Revenue has compounded 49.9% a year over 5 years
Growth is speeding up: revenue 58.9% a year over 3 years vs 49.9% over 5

bear.text: New Noida facility start: promised Operations from Q2 FY27, got Now expected from Q3 FY27

items.quote: Revenues for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, was INR15,557 crores.

claims.summary: The one company-wide figure management read out on the last 2 calls matches the reported results.
claims.note: Each figure management read out on the call is recomputed from the quarterly results the company filed, consolidated and standalone, with EBITDA both before and after other income. A figure is only called a mismatch when the call clearly speaks about the whole company.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years operating cash flow was 108% of reported profit, so profit is turning into cash.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 49 days to pay, against 51 three years ago.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was 38% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. A large part of profit does not come from the core business.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit grew 33% while operating profit grew 24%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 23%, against 19% on average over the four quarters before.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: No unusual jump in other income in Sep 2026.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 0.21× equity, against 0.22× two years earlier.

checks.title: Promoters are not selling
checks.text: Promoters hold 28.5%, down 0.4 points over the last 4 reported quarters.
